blends.name: Chronowyrm
blends.desc:
![](https://i.imgur.com/s3tUli0.png)

A mini time dragon hatched from an egg found in a dimensional rift. His ability to briefly slow time around him allows him to dodge deadly attacks. His scales change color depending on the era he "feels" and he can sometimes predict near future events. Extremely rare and difficult to tame.

**To obtain this Pet, you need:**
* 2 Purified Etherium Liquid		
* 2 Dimensional Chromium Prism	
* 2 Volatile Antimatter
* 2 Purified Nano-Metal

*To obtain materials, you can open your **Quantum Chest** [here](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/planetdefnft/blends/blend.nefty/41033).*

blends.desc:

A genetically modified flying feline, the result of abandoned military experiments. Its membranous wings and reinforced alloy claws allow it to attack in flight and carry its master short distances. Its changing coat provides camouflage in various environments.

**To obtain this Pet, you need:**
* 2 Compressed Etherium Liquid	
* 2 Volatile Antimatter
* 2 Purified Nano-Metal
* 2 Condensed Oreon	

*To obtain materials, you can open your **Quantum Chest** [here](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/planetdefnft/blends/blend.nefty/41033).*

blends.name: Luminyx
blends.desc:
![](https://i.imgur.com/zqOb1WO.png)

A semi-sentient bioluminescent mushroom that attaches itself to its owner's shoulder via small symbiotic roots. Its glow varies depending on surrounding dangers and it can absorb certain toxins to protect its host. Its spores can temporarily blind enemies or illuminate dark areas. It pulses to the rhythm of its companion's emotions.

**To obtain this Pet, you need:**
* 1 Perfected Quantum Crystal	
* 2 Purified Nano-Metal
* 2 Exalted Plasmo-Fibers

*To obtain materials, you can open your **Quantum Chest** [here](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/planetdefnft/blends/blend.nefty/41033).*

blends.desc:

This canine species is the result of a cross between a Earth dog embryo and a Ma-Boar. With its heat-resistant fur and superior intelligence, this dog is excellent for protection and searching for objects. Affectionately nicknamed "Hotdog" by its creators.

**To obtain this Pet, you need:**
